    Twisted traces on a star (Lemmas A.2 and A.4) #

    lem:twisted-trace-surjection, lem:arm-trace-reduction (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Let π : ℤΔ → Q be a covering of a star model with signed coefficients, and let (v, t) ↦ (σ v, t + s) be a deck transformation with σ fixing the centre. In degree d = m + 1 = 2 + s, the row class of a closed path at a σ-fixed vertex v (phiV) is independent of the height, kills the relations of Π(Δ), and satisfies twisted rotation.

          Outward backtracks on a fixed arm have zero trace: rotating the first arrow turns y_r^q into z_{r+1}^q, which the mesh at r + 1 identifies with y_{r+1}^q, or kills at the leaf.
